title: You Eat Everything
description: This mod turns every item in Minecraft into edible food. Become the ultimate glutton and rule the world one block at a time!
body:
Hungry? Eat literally everything!

Have you ever looked at a block of dirt or a diamond sword and thought, "That looks delicious"? Well, now you can finally eat it! Eat Everything turns every single item in Minecraft into edible food.

![EAT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/731157ab37145de6467c0c48b6bb3fb75e84f7f0.gif)

Key Features:
   * Eat Anything: Every item in the game is now edible. Yes, everything.
   * Material-Based Buffs: Eating different materials grants special effects!
   * Metals (Iron, Gold, Diamond): Gain Resistance and Strength.
   * Explosives (TNT, Gunpowder): Trigger an explosion (and yes, you are immune to the damage!).
   * Hot Items (Torches, Magma): Become fireproof (but take a little heat!).
   * XP Rewards: Eating rare items grants you Experience Points. The rarer the item, the more XP you get!
   * Iron Belly Progression: Eating hard materials (stone, dirt, ores) is tough at first, but the more you eat, the
     stronger your stomach becomes, reducing nausea and slowness effects over time.
   * Sneak to Eat: Handling "large or complex" items like buckets and tridents requires a bit of finesse—you must be
     sneaking (crouching) to consume them.
   * Totem Power: Eating a Totem of Undying is a legendary meal that restores your health and grants powerful
     regeneration buffs.

If you like this mod, consider following my channel for more updates! https://www.youtube.com/@mrjolubkom
